PhysicalLine.description: One line with a box and ordered OCR tokens.

c.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

t.description: OCR tokens in line order; Impresso permits an empty list.

PhysicalLine.title: PhysicalLine

PhysicalPage.description: One Impresso page file, with its picture metadata and physical text hierarchy. Impresso allows unknown properties at every object level; no such properties are defined here. Exactly one image key and at least one timestamp key must be present.

cc.description: Whether legacy coordinates were converted or rescaled to the IIIF picture frame.

cdt.description: Legacy JSON creation timestamp; Impresso validates a string without a date format.

fh.description: Facsimile height in pixels; present together with fw, with no bound in Impresso.

fw.description: Facsimile width in pixels; present together with fh, with no bound in Impresso.

id.description: Impresso's canonical page identifier; for example FABLE-1900-01-01-a-p0001.

iiif.description: Deprecated IIIF manifest URI, retained for compatibility; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax. Exactly one of this and iiif_img_base_uri is present.

iiif_img_base_uri.description: Base IIIF image URI without a suffix; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax.

r.description: Regions in page order; an empty list is accepted by Impresso.

sm.description: Original source medium; present together with st.

st.description: Media source type; present together with sm. Newspaper requires print; radio_broadcast requires typescript.

ts.description: JSON creation timestamp, intended as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; Impresso imposes no format constraint. At least one of ts and cdt is present; both are allowed.

PhysicalPage.title: PhysicalPage

PhysicalParagraph.description: One ordered group of lines in a region, optionally with its own box; no computed id is assigned to paragraphs by this contract.

c.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

l.description: Lines in paragraph order, including an empty list if stored that way.

PhysicalParagraph.title: PhysicalParagraph

PhysicalRegion.description: One region of the page, with a box, ordered paragraphs and optional semantic links.

c.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

p.description: Paragraphs in region order; Impresso permits zero, one or several.

pOf.description: Canonical content-item id, absent or null when no item is assigned.

section_pOf.description: Content-item ids grouped by this section-heading region. The list may be absent or null; Impresso also permits null members and empty lists.

PhysicalRegion.title: PhysicalRegion

PhysicalWord.description: One OCR token (a word or word part), with its own box and surface text.

c.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

gn.description: Glue next: true means no following whitespace. When absent readers assume false; the schema inserts no default.

hy.description: Whether this token is the first part of a hyphenated word, including the hyphen. Readers assume false when absent; the schema inserts no default.

nf.description: Normalized dehyphenated form on the latter part or parts of a hyphenated word.

s.description: Style id in the separate issue file's s list; no style fields are added here.

tx.description: Token surface text, including empty text if stored that way.

PhysicalWord.title: PhysicalWord
